entries.compatibility: Additive field on pending jobs only, written before claim or when a never-spawned claimed job returns to pending at the spawn-time recheck, and removed when the owner lookup reports no live owner. No round is charged, an operator override survives, and spawned in-progress jobs are never read or rewritten by this path.
